definitions.explanation: Words, actions, or things that bring comfort or relief to someone who is sad, suffering, or distressed.
Something that provides entertainment or distraction from boredom or hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{慰|なぐさ}めになった。
examples.english: Her words were a comfort to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰|なぐさ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a letter of consolation from a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{慰|なぐさ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{消|き}えなかった→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: No matter what words of comfort I offered, his sadness wouldn't go away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰|なぐさ}めだった。
⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰|なぐさ}めになっている。
examples.english: Reading serves as a daily diversion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧、⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{慰|なぐさ}めになっている。
examples.english: For my grandmother who lives alone, her cat is a great source of comfort.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {慰|なぐさ}める (to comfort, to console). Can refer both to emotional consolation and to things that serve as amusement or solace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慰|なぐさ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: words of comfort
- {慰|なぐさ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as consolation/comfort
- {気休|きやす}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰|なぐさ}め: hollow comfort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧: healing, soothing — focuses on therapeutic relief
- ⟦{励|はげ}まし→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧: encouragement — focuses on motivating someone forward
- ⟦{慰安|いあん}→慰安：27804_ian⟧: comfort, recreation — more formal; often used in compounds like {慰安旅行|いあんりょこう} (company trip)
